summary: Added sdk/reports/battles.py: JournalBattle and battles_from_events (attempted run_pvp_battle events only; win/loss only for verified + outcome-observed + non-zero observed trophy delta; strategy from the experiment window at battle start; battle id from evidence or attempt id; hull/trophy cohort brackets, unknown unless recorded). EvidenceBuilder now receives the snapshot delta and battle evidence records trophies_delta (None when unobserved). Exported from sdk.reports. 9 tests in tests/test_battle_results_from_journal.py including a runner-to-journal-to-result round trip. Documented in docs/baseline/pvp-battle-results.md.

contract_status_changes.contract: PvP battle results from the journal
contract_status_changes.before: Journaled battles could not be turned into BattleResult records and the trophy change was not journaled
contract_status_changes.after: Each attempted battle yields a BattleResult with observed-only outcomes, strategy attribution and cohort labels

residual_risks: No journaled event records opponent hull or trophies yet, so every cohort is unknown until a battle read is verified.
The existing sdk.pvp attack_win_rate counts unknown outcomes in its denominator; the scorecard slice must use known-result rates.
